case_number: WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 215 OF 2005; MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATION NO. 1699 OF 2019
summary: Right to die with dignity; Advance Medical Directives upheld; procedural safeguards prescribed for execution, preservation, and implementation; mandatory role of Judicial Magistrate, Medical Boards, Collector; revocation provisions; terminally ill patients; life support withdrawal; constitutional validity under Article 21; intra-court appeal clarification sought.
final_judgment: Application allowed; clarification granted as per directives issued; procedural framework for Advance Medical Directives affirmed.
